card.name: Spots where "eventually" could come next
card.fires_on: Responds at points in a sentence where an adverb like "eventually" or "possibly" could be inserted: after modal verbs (could), after "and" or "will", after a comma following "However", or at a dash or parenthesis. Mostly general prose, plus all-caps warning text.

modes.label: Before a verb
modes.description: A space or modal word right before a main verb, where an adverb like "eventually" could fit.
modes.example: most have no symptoms and<< >>clear the infection on their own, according

modes.label: After a comma or conjunction
modes.description: A comma after "However" or "and" in a list of outcomes, where an adverb of time or likelihood may follow.
modes.example: CARDIAC ARREST AND<<,>> POSSIBLY, DEATH. Meth

modes.label: Modal verb in headline
modes.description: The word "could" in a claim about what may happen.
modes.example: OTHER RENEWABLE POWER SOURCES CO<<ULD>> MEET NEARLY ALL NORTH CAR

card.writes: It promotes "eventually" and "event" forms as the next word.
card.plain: It fires where a word like "eventually" could slot in before the main verb.
